youtube.title: What If You Moved to the Real Leonida? #Shorts
youtube.description:
What if you moved to the real Leonida? GTA 6's map is a made-up Florida, so Remy packs a bag and tries the real one.

Florida has around 1.3 million alligators, living in all 67 counties, but serious alligator injuries are rare and most gators avoid people. The bigger danger is above you: Florida gets more lightning per square kilometer than any other US state and has led the country in lightning deaths for years. And roughly 40% of all US hurricane landfalls are in Florida.

The real rules: watch the sky, not just the water. When thunder roars, go indoors. In the game you respawn. In real life, the weather doesn't care.

Would you still move to Leonida? A beaches, B gators, C never, D I already live there.

Sources:
- Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC), alligators (about 1.3 million, all 67 counties): https://myfwc.com/news/all-news/gators-325/
- FWC, living with alligators (serious injuries are rare): https://myfwc.com/wildlifehabitats/wildlife/alligator/snap/
- WUSF (2026), Florida, the lightning capital of the US: https://www.wusf.org/weather/2026-01-04/florida-lightning-capital-us-is-climate-change-making-it-worse
- CBS News, Florida leads the nation in lightning strikes: https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/florida-overwhelming-leads-the-nation-in-lightning-strikes
- CDC, lightning data and research: https://www.cdc.gov/lightning/data-research/
- AccuWeather / NOAA HURDAT, which states are hit most by hurricanes: https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/in-depth-analysis-of-us-hurricanes-which-states-are-hit-most-frequently-by-devastating-storms/347725
- "When thunder roars, go indoors" is the US National Weather Service lightning safety slogan.

Remy is fictional. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. No game footage, art, logos or maps are used.
AI disclosure: made with AI assistance (script drafting, synthetic narration voice, animation).
